paper_title: Breaking Bias, Building Bridges Evaluation and Mitigation of Social   Biases in LLMs via Contact Hypothesis
caption: Lighter shaded bars show the percentage of prompts that generate biased responses before instruction tuning, whereas darker shaded bars correspond to the same after instruction tuning. Darker bars begin at the top of the lighter bars (for example, for the first bar, the lighter bar is 39.50%, and the darker bar is only 0.04%). Takeaway: Instruction-tuning on certain key principles eliminates bias to nearly zero (visualized by the absence of dark bars) across prompts specific to Support of Authorities and Extended Contact, also considerably reducing bias across Virtual Contact prompts.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the percentage of biased responses generated by prompts before and after instruction tuning, categorized by pre-contact conditions. The horizontal axis represents three categories: "No Contact Before," "Positive Contact Before," and "Virtual Contact Before." The vertical axis is labeled "Bias Percentage" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70 with tick labels at intervals of 10. There are six bars for each category, visually paired to show bias before and after instruction tuning; the lighter-shaded bars represent the percentage of biased responses before instruction tuning, while the darker-shaded bars represent the percentage after. The color scheme distinguishes between "No Contact Before" (light blue), "Positive Contact Before" (red), and "Negative Contact Before" (dark blue). The shortest bar, with a value of 0.00, corresponds to "Positive Contact Before" before instruction tuning, while the tallest bar depicting bias after instruction tuning has a value of 47.28, associated with "Negative Contact Before". The bars representing outcomes after instruction tuning are stacked on top of the bars representing outcomes before. The first three bars (corresponding to “No Contact Before,” “Positive Contact Before,” and “Virtual Contact Before”) show numbers pre-tuning of 39.50, 0.00, and 36.13 respectively, with corresponding post-tuning values of 0.04, 0.00, and 10.01. The final three bars, labeled as “Negative Contact Before” pre-tuning, show values of 42.38, 39.74, and 43.83, associated with post-tuning values of 10.00, 39.17, and 10.02 respectively. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order beyond the original category, and there is no explicit visual emphasis applied to any particular bar.
